texts: good. the when-clause parses as a fireable rule: the low moth-count is the trigger and the cliff-spire position the consequence, with the lantern, the count and the spires all typed and linked. The only thing not recorded is the continuation sense of 'stay' (it reads as a plain 'are on the cliff-spires'), and no simple rewording recovers it, so the sentence is fine as written.

good. parses as a fireable per-keeper rule at strength 0 — for any keeper, a feeding of sky-cats is denied — with the sky-cat kind carried as the object and no content dropped. Worth knowing only that a bare plural on both sides of the verb could equally land on a single opaque kind-level record ('keepers feed sky-cats' as one relation atom) in a future re-parse; both forms are faithful, so no rewrite is needed.
